phases.label: 制定方案
phases.note: 15/15 个镜头要改，6 张关键画面

plan.subject: The user's Li Auto i8, a large pearl-white SUV with a glossy black roof, dark pillars, a continuous tinted window band, a long rounded body, flush door handles, black lower trim, two-tone mirrors, and large silver-and-dark aerodynamic wheels; preserve the exact proportions and exterior details visible in the reference photo.
plan.target: The featured metallic silver-grey Firefly compact five-door hatchback, with a dark roof, rounded upright body, black front fascia, central Firefly emblem, three circular light elements at each front corner, dark wheels, and a pale cabin with a rounded rectangular steering wheel, small instrument display, and landscape center touchscreen.
plan.keep: Preserve all shot timings, cuts, framing, camera movements, action beats, pacing, narrative sequence, people, clothing, shoes, phones, hand gestures, surrounding vehicles, roads, buildings, vegetation, weather, and lighting.
plan.change: Replace the featured Firefly car throughout all exterior, cabin, and screen shots with the user's pearl-white Li Auto i8, using supplied references for unseen details and verified recordings for actual functions while adapting model names, narration, and captions accordingly.
plan.summary: 将全片萤火虫汽车的外观、内饰及车机展示统一替换为你图中的珍珠白理想 i8，保留原片镜头、动作和节奏，涉及设置的界面与讲解按你的实车操作调整。

gaps.label: 辅助驾驶设置连续操作
gaps.need: 请在车辆停稳时，从打开设置的第一步开始连续拍一条实车视频，拍清中控屏、手指落点及每步操作后的页面；按原片顺序展示对应功能：进入辅助驾驶页面、选择领航辅助模式、设置变道确认方式、设置通行效率偏好、开启智能灯光提醒、下滑找到限速调整并展示百分比及原片所述 10% 设置是否存在、最后展示辅助驾驶提示灯的开关。理想 i8 的名称、路径或可选项不同就按实车实际操作拍摄，没有的功能请说明，并提供当前软件版本。
gaps.fallback: 去掉未经证实的点击步骤、菜单路径、参数数值及功能效果承诺，在对应时段使用用户提供的真实车机静态画面或已有可靠素材，保留镜头时长和讲解节奏；字幕与旁白改为“查看辅助驾驶设置，具体选项以本车当前版本为准”，不生成虚构界面。

scenes.edit: Replace the parked foreground Firefly with the reference Li Auto i8 in the same front three-quarter orientation, anchoring its tires to the pavement and preserving perspective; retain the man approaching with his phone, his crossing path and occlusion, the background white car, railings, trees, and overcast light, and map the timed lamp response to verified i8 lamp geometry.

Replace the visible driving cabin with the user's verified i8 cockpit, preserving the driver's viewpoint, hands, clothing, road view, traffic, sunlight, and steering action; use one keyframe showing both hands contacting the actual i8 wheel and the surrounding dashboard, and use verified display material without inventing assistance indicators.

Replace the moving Firefly with the pearl-white, black-roof Li Auto i8 using a clear head-on highway keyframe to establish vehicle identity, front geometry, wheel design, and the visible driver; carry that identity through all front and side tracking angles while preserving vehicle trajectories, camera distance changes, lane positions, wheel rotation, road reflections, and motion blur.

Replace the parked Firefly with the user's i8 in the same front three-quarter composition beside the yellow road marking, retaining the foreground pointing hand, the car behind it, building reflections, trees, and warm sunlight; preserve hand occlusion and establish the actual i8 front lighting and body proportions.

Replace the open-door Firefly cabin and visible exterior door frame with the actual i8 front cabin and pearl-white bodywork, using supplied interior references to establish the steering wheel, dashboard, screen arrangement, upholstery, seat, and console together; preserve the original doorway viewpoint, camera drift, greenery, daylight, and empty-seat composition.

Replace the Firefly center screen, surrounding dashboard, and on-screen vehicle representation with the actual i8 hardware and verified interface footage; use one minimally occluded keyframe to establish screen placement, cabin materials, the hand's approach, and the outdoor column-and-grass background, then follow the real recorded settings sequence across every screen shot and adapt captions and narration to supported functions.

shots.note: The car is parked in front three-quarter view; a man holding a phone approaches from frame right and walks across its nose, briefly occluding the front lamps and body as the lamps change state.

The car is seen from the driver's seated viewpoint while traveling on a highway; the steering wheel, instrument display, center screen, door trim, and windshield frame surround the driver's legs, with the right hand contacting the lower-right wheel and the left hand resting near the lap.
The moving car is tracked from a low front three-quarter angle that becomes nearly head-on; its nose, windshield, roof, mirrors, rotating wheels, and driver are visible against the highway.
The car travels alongside the camera in a wider front three-quarter view approaching a side profile, with its front pointing toward frame left and its wheels rotating.
The car is stationary in a close front three-quarter view near a yellow road line; a foreground hand sweeps toward it and points at its front lamp area, while another car remains parked behind.

The unoccupied front cabin is viewed through the open driver's doorway; the camera drifts across the steering wheel, instrument area, center touchscreen, front seat, console, and visible painted door frame.

The parked car's center touchscreen fills the frame at an oblique angle; a right hand selects assistance settings, changes the assistance mode, and selects a lane-change confirmation option, with dashboard trim and roadside columns visible around it.

The moving cabin is shown from the driver's viewpoint during a lane-change sequence; both hands contact the lower sides of the steering wheel, with instrument graphics and a camera view visible on the original displays.
A right index finger touches the traffic-efficiency setting on the parked car's assistance screen, then lowers toward the screen edge; the display and surrounding dashboard remain prominent.

The highway driving viewpoint continues with both hands on the wheel and the car advancing relative to surrounding traffic; the instrument display, center screen, dashboard, and windshield surround remain visible.
A right hand scrolls the parked car's assistance page and taps the intelligent light-reminder switch, which changes to an enabled state on the original screen.
The moving car is tracked beside highway sound barriers, shifting between a close front three-quarter view and a more distant head-on view; the driver remains visible through the windshield.

The center screen is shown in a tighter oblique close-up while a right index finger navigates the speed-offset section, selects percentage adjustment, and interacts with the numeric control; the original caption specifies ten percent.
The car approaches in a front three-quarter highway tracking view, grows larger, and passes toward a closer side angle; its front, near-side doors, mirrors, and rotating wheels become prominent.
The parked car's assistance screen remains in close-up as a right hand scrolls and points toward the assistance-indicator-light option; the display housing and surrounding dashboard stay visible.
